correctness.rationale: Homogeneity makes a labelled admissible diagram over the fixed parameters exactly one tuple type. For the antipodal representation, one can anchor at a vertex x and use the half-circle from x to x′: put its outneighbors there as primaries and its inneighbors as antipodes. Their relative order is the given arc order within either part and the reversed arc order across the parts. A cycle in that order would be a mixed directed triangle; adjoining x would exhibit a directed triangle entirely in some vertex's in- or out-neighborhood. Thus that half has a unique linear order, and the antipodal half is determined. Conversely the geometric orientation has transitive neighborhoods, since each lies in an open half-circle. The parameter restriction is therefore the unique old-symbol sequence for the named transitive block. Choosing the gap of h₁ fixes the gap of its antipode; exactly one old symbol of each pair is between them. The remaining primaries must be in this open semicircle, in prescribed order; every weak composition into the n+1 consecutive gaps is realizable, and determines the unique labelled cyclic order including the new antipodes. The forward weight is a_s+Σ a_(s+j)b_j, giving the displayed complete homogeneous sum. Rotating just the new block by a half-turn preserves its internal arcs and reverses every cross arc; degree nr is attained by using the all-forward gap. Counting compositions at z=1 gives the total. Fresh integer enumeration of all 2^(nr) cross assignments for all 28 ordered pairs through size eight tested each neighborhood by its outdegree multiset 0,…,d−1 (equivalent to transitivity by removing the highest-degree vertex), and matched direct composition expansion coefficient by coefficient. The displayed vectors are correct: the first valleys include (26,24,24,26) for (3,5) and (33,28,34) for (4,4); swapping blocks gives (5,3). The exhaustive check found no earlier or other size-eight failures.
residual_risks: Fresh enumeration is finite and independent of the all-order proof; no classification beyond total size eight is inferred. The supplied checker was not executed.
